Correction MLP with GELU + LayerNorm -> delta -> eps-clipped\n\nInput: base_action (30D) + multi_scale_obs (4x960D or fallback 1x960D)\nOutput: refined_action (30D) = base_action + clipped_delta\nParams: ~327K\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nEXTRACT_LAYERS = [3, 7, 11, 15]\n\n\nclass MultiScaleFeatureExtractor:\n    \"\"\"Extract intermediate hidden states from SmolVLA VLM text_model via forward hooks.\n\n    During SmolVLAWrapper.encode_prefix, the VLM text model processes prefix tokens\n    through 16 LlamaDecoderLayers. This extractor captures hidden states at specified\n    layer boundaries without modifying existing code.\n\n    Hooks:\n      - Layer N (N < 15): hook on layers[N+1].input_layernorm INPUT -> layer N output\n      - Layer 15: hook on text_model.norm OUTPUT -> post-norm final representation\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, text_model, layer_indices=None):\n        self.text_model = text_model\n        self.layer_indices = layer_indices or EXTRACT_LAYERS\n        self.captured = {}\n        self._hooks = []\n\n    def _make_input_hook(self, layer_idx):\n        def hook_fn(module, inp, out):\n            self.captured[layer_idx] = inp[0].detach()\n        return hook_fn\n\n    def _make_output_hook(self, layer_idx):\n        def hook_fn(module, inp, out):\n            self.captured[layer_idx] = out.detach()\n        return hook_fn\n\n    def register(self):\n        self.remove()\n        num_layers = len(self.text_model.layers)\n        for idx in self.layer_indices:\n            if idx < num_layers - 1:\n                hook = self.text_model.layers[idx + 1].input_layernorm.register_forward_hook(\n                    self._make_input_hook(idx)\n                )\n            else:\n                hook = self.text_model.norm.register_forward_hook(\n                    self._make_output_hook(idx)\n                )\n            self._hooks.append(hook)\n\n    def remove(self):\n        for h in self._hooks:\n            h.remove()\n        self._hooks = []\n        self.captured = {}\n\n    def get_features(self, pad_mask):\n        \"\"\"Mean-pool captured hidden states using pad_mask -> list of (B, 960).\"\"\"\n        features = []\n        mask = pad_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()\n        for idx in self.layer_indices:\n            h = self.captured[idx].float()\n            pooled = (h * mask).sum(1) / mask.sum(1).clamp(min=1)\n            features.append(pooled)\n        return features\n\n    @contextmanager\n    def capture(self):\n        self.register()\n        self.captured = {}\n        try:\n            yield self\n        finally:\n            self.remove()\n\n\nclass MultiScaleCRM(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"K=1 CRM with multi-scale VLM feature fusion and action-conditioned correction.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, action_dim=30, obs_dim=960,\n                 hidden_dim=256, bottleneck_dim=192,\n                 num_scale_layers=4,\n                 max_correction_norm=1.42):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.action_dim = action_dim\n        self.obs_dim = obs_dim\n        self.bottleneck_dim = bottleneck_dim\n        self.num_scale_layers = num_scale_layers\n        self.max_correction_norm = max_correction_norm\n\n        # Shared bottleneck for all VLM layer features\n        self.layer_proj = nn.Linear(obs_dim, bottleneck_dim)\n\n        # Action-conditioned correction gate: the proposed action encodes the VLA\n        # error pattern (spatial misalignment vs wrong grasp angle vs wrong target),\n        # which determines which projected feature dimensions carry correction signal\n        self.correction_gate = nn.Sequential(\n            nn.Linear(action_dim, bottleneck_dim),\n            nn.Sigmoid(),\n        )\n        # Per-layer learned importance: early VLM layers encode spatial layout,\n        # later layers encode semantic task state; their relative contribution\n        # to correction depends on the distribution of VLA error types\n        self.layer_importance = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_scale_layers))\n\n        # Action query for attention over multi-scale features\n        self.action_query_proj = nn.Linear(action_dim, bottleneck_dim)\n\n        # Correction MLP\n        mlp_input_dim = action_dim + bottleneck_dim\n        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(\n            nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim, hidden_dim),\n            nn.GELU(),\n            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),\n            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),\n            nn.GELU(),\n            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, action_dim),\n        )\n\n        # Per-layer normalization buffers\n        self.register_buffer(\"action_mean\", torch.zeros(action_dim))\n        self.register_buffer(\"action_std\", torch.ones(action_dim))\n        self.register_buffer(\"obs_mean\", torch.zeros(num_scale_layers, obs_dim))\n        self.register_buffer(\"obs_std\", torch.ones(num_scale_layers, obs_dim))\n\n        # Residual init: last layer near zero\n        nn.init.zeros_(self.mlp[-1].weight)\n        nn.init.zeros_(self.mlp[-1].bias)\n\n    def forward(self, base_action, multi_scale_obs):\n        \"\"\"\n        Args:\n            base_action: (B, action_dim)\n            multi_scale_obs: list of (B, obs_dim) from VLM layers,\n                             or single (B, obs_dim) tensor for fallback\n        Returns:\n            refined_action: (B, action_dim)\n        \"\"\"\n        action_norm = (base_action - self.action_mean) / (self.action_std + 1e-8)\n\n        # Action-conditioned gate: selects which feature dimensions carry correction signal\n        gate = self.correction_gate(action_norm)\n\n        # Fallback: single obs feature -> skip attention\n        if isinstance(multi_scale_obs, torch.Tensor) and multi_scale_obs.dim() == 2:\n            feat_norm = (multi_scale_obs - self.obs_mean[-1]) / (self.obs_std[-1] + 1e-8)\n            fused = self.layer_proj(feat_norm) * gate\n        else:\n            # Normalized layer importance weights\n            layer_w = F.softmax(self.layer_importance, dim=0)\n\n            projected = []\n            for i, feat in enumerate(multi_scale_obs):\n                idx = min(i, self.num_scale_layers - 1)\n                feat_norm = (feat - self.obs_mean[idx]) / (self.obs_std[idx] + 1e-8)\n                p = self.layer_proj(feat_norm)\n                # Gate modulates features per-dimension, layer_w scales per-layer\n                p = p * gate * layer_w[idx]\n                projected.append(p)\n\n            features = torch.stack(projected, dim=1)\n            query = self.action_query_proj(action_norm).unsqueeze(1)\n            attn_logits = (query * features).sum(-1) / (self.bottleneck_dim ** 0.5)\n            attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)\n            fused = (attn_weights.unsqueeze(-1) * features).sum(1)\n\n        x = torch.cat([action_norm, fused], dim=-1)\n        delta = self.mlp(x)\n\n        # Epsilon-bound norm clipping\n        delta_norm = delta.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)\n        delta = delta * torch.clamp(self.max_correction_norm / (delta_norm + 1e-8), max=1.0)\n\n        return base_action + delta\n\n    def set_normalization_stats(self, action_mean, action_std, obs_mean, obs_std):\n        \"\"\"Set input normalization buffers.\n\n        Args:\n            action_mean: (action_dim,)\n            action_std: (action_dim,)\n            obs_mean: (num_scale_layers, obs_dim) or (obs_dim,)\n            obs_std: (num_scale_layers, obs_dim) or (obs_dim,)\n        \"\"\"\n        self.action_mean.copy_(action_mean)\n        self.action_std.copy_(action_std)\n        if obs_mean.dim() == 1:\n            self.obs_mean[:] = obs_mean.unsqueeze(0)\n            self.obs_std[:] = obs_std.unsqueeze(0)\n        else:\n            self.obs_mean.copy_(obs_mean)\n            self.obs_std.copy_(obs_std)\n\n    def count_parameters(self):\n        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)\n\n\nclass CRMMultiLoss(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"Combined loss for K=1 CRM training.\n\n    Components:\n      - L2 residual: MSE(refined, expert)\n      - Direction-aware: 1 - cosine_similarity(delta_pred, delta_true)\n        Corrected action should move in the same direction as the expert correction.\n      - Triplet improvement: max(0, margin + d(refined,expert) - d(vla,expert))\n        Corrected action must be closer to expert than the original VLA action.\n      - Correction magnitude: ||delta||^2 regularization\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, lambda_dir=0.1, lambda_tri=0.05, lambda_mag=0.01,\n                 triplet_margin=0.01, dir_threshold=0.01):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.lambda_dir = lambda_dir\n        self.lambda_tri = lambda_tri\n        self.lambda_mag = lambda_mag\n        self.triplet_margin = triplet_margin\n        self.dir_threshold = dir_threshold\n\n    def forward(self, refined, expert, base_action):\n        \"\"\"Returns (total_loss, loss_dict).\"\"\"\n        l2_loss = F.mse_loss(refined, expert)\n\n        delta_pred = refined - base_action\n        delta_true = expert - base_action\n\n        # Direction loss (only on samples with meaningful correction)\n        delta_true_norm = delta_true.norm(dim=-1)\n        valid = delta_true_norm > self.dir_threshold\n        if valid.any():\n            dir_loss = (1 - F.cosine_similarity(\n                delta_pred[valid], delta_true[valid], dim=-1\n            )).mean()\n        else:\n            dir_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=refined.device)\n\n        # Triplet improvement loss\n        d_refined = (refined - expert).norm(dim=-1)\n        d_vla = (base_action - expert).norm(dim=-1)\n        tri_loss = F.relu(self.triplet_margin + d_refined - d_vla).mean()\n\n        # Magnitude regularization\n        mag_loss = delta_pred.pow(2).mean()\n\n        total = (l2_loss\n                 + self.lambda_dir * dir_loss\n                 + self.lambda_tri * tri_loss\n                 + self.lambda_mag * mag_loss)\n\n        return total, {\n            \"l2\": l2_loss.item(),\n            \"dir\": dir_loss.item(),\n            \"tri\": tri_loss.item(),\n            \"mag\": mag_loss.item(),\n            \"total\": total.item(),\n        }\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(\"MultiScaleCRM (K=1) verification\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n\n    model = MultiScaleCRM()\n    n_params = model.count_parameters()\n    print(f\"\\nTotal parameters: {n_params:,}\")\n    print(f\"  layer_proj:        {sum(p.numel() for p in model.layer_proj.parameters()):,}\")\n    print(f\"  correction_gate:   {sum(p.numel() for p in model.correction_gate.parameters()):,}\")\n    print(f\"  layer_importance:  {model.layer_importance.numel():,}\")\n    print(f\"  action_query_proj: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.action_query_proj.parameters()):,}\")\n    print(f\"  MLP:               {sum(p.numel() for p in model.mlp.parameters()):,}\")\n\n    B = 4\n\n    # Multi-scale forward\n    action = torch.randn(B, 30)\n    obs_list = [torch.randn(B, 960) for _ in range(4)]\n    out = model(action, obs_list)\n    print(f\"\\nMulti-scale forward: action {action.shape} -> output {out.shape}\")\n    assert out.shape == (B, 30), f\"Shape mismatch: {out.shape}\"\n\n    # Single-scale fallback\n    obs_single = torch.randn(B, 960)\n    out2 = model(action, obs_single)\n    print(f\"Fallback forward:    action {action.shape}, obs {obs_single.shape} -> output {out2.shape}\")\n    assert out2.shape == (B, 30), f\"Shape mismatch: {out2.shape}\"\n\n    # Correction norm clipping\n    model.max_correction_norm = 0.1\n    out3 = model(action, obs_list)\n    delta_norms = (out3 - action).norm(dim=-1)\n    print(f\"\\nCorrection norms (eps={model.max_correction_norm}): \"\n          f\"max={delta_norms.max().item():.4f}\")\n    assert (delta_norms <= model.max_correction_norm + 1e-5).all(), \"Norm clipping failed\"\n\n    # Loss computation\n    loss_fn = CRMMultiLoss()\n    expert = action + torch.randn(B, 30) * 0.1\n    total_loss, loss_dict = loss_fn(out3, expert, action)\n    print(f\"\\nLoss components:\")\n    for k, v in loss_dict.items():\n        print(f\"  {k}: {v:.6f}\")\n\n    # Gradient flow\n    model.max_correction_norm = 1.42\n    model.zero_grad()\n    out4 = model(action, obs_list)\n    loss, _ = loss_fn(out4, expert, action)\n    loss.backward()\n    grad_norms = {name: p.grad.norm().item()\n                  for name, p in model.named_parameters()\n                  if p.grad is not None}\n    print(f\"\\nGradient norms (all modules):\")\n    for name, gn in sorted(grad_norms.items()):\n        print(f\"  {name}: {gn:.6f}\")\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'=' * 60}\")\n    print(\"All checks passed!\")\n    print(f\"{'=' * 60}\")\nCRMPYEOF\necho \"written ok\""

FiLM's static per-layer affine transform cannot adapt to per-sample error structure. delta)。Per-DOF claim 在 spatial 上已死。项目存活依赖：\n1. ~~Magnitude sweep 找到 perdof 显著优于 argmin 的 norm 点~~ ✘ (perdof 全 norm=11% on object)\n2. ~~Object benchmark 跨域验证~~ ✘ (perdof dead)\n3. **obs_only CRM → 转向 \"learned correction\" narrative** ← 唯一路径，但 seed 方差大\n\n## Object Baseline (2026-05-15, 更新 2026-05-17)\n\n**VLA-only K=1 object**: seed42=12%, seed43=12%, seed44=10%, seed45=9%。四 seed 稳定 9-12%。\n\n**VLA-mean K=10 object**: seed42=12%, seed43=15%, seed44=10%, seed45=13%。四 seed mean=12.5%，与 VLA-only K=1 几乎无差异。Mean aggregation 在 object benchmark 上无增益。\n\n## OpenVLA 适配进展 (2026-05-17)\n\n### Issue A: LIBERO-Object Checkpoint\n\n**状态**: 下载中（~15GB via hf-mirror.com）\n**HuggingFace 仓库**: `openvla/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-object`（官方 LoRA r=32 fine-tune）\n**本地路径**: `/root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-libero-object/`\n**注意**: bjb1-18228 无法直接访问 huggingface.co，必须设 `HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com`（在 ~/.bashrc 中已配置，但 nohup/background 进程需要手动 source）\n\n### Issue B: 特征提取已实现\n\n**方案**: Forward hook on `language_model.model.layers[31]`（最后一层 Llama decoder layer）\n\n**技术细节**:\n- Transformers 5.8.0 的 `generate()` 在 prefill 阶段不经过标准 PyTorch forward hooks\n- Prefill 通过内部优化路径填充 KV cache，forward hooks 只捕获 decode 阶段\n- 解决方案：捕获第一个 decode step 的 hidden state（conditioned on 完整 observation via KV cache）\n- Hook output 是 raw tensor `(1, 1, 4096)`（不是 tuple），需 `squeeze(1)` 而非 `output[0].mean(dim=1)`\n\n**验证结果**:\n- obs_features shape: (1, 4096)，norm=4256，非零\n- 同一 image 的 cosine_similarity=1.0（特征一致性确认）\n- K=1 和 K=3 都正确工作\n\n### Issue C: chunk_size/action_dim 参数化完成\n\n**修改文件**:\n1. `src/utils.py`: 新增 `VLA_CONFIGS` dict 和 `get_vla_config()` 函数\n2. `src/openvla_wrapper.py`: 实现真实特征提取（替换全零返回）\n3. `src/openvla_eval.py`: 支持 CRM modes（obs_only/perdof/scalar/reconvla），维度全部从 VLA_CONFIGS 读取\n\n**维度对比**:\n\n| 参数 | SmolVLA | OpenVLA |\n|------|---------|---------|\n| h_eff | 5 | 1 |\n| correction_dim | 6 | 6 |\n| obs_dim | 960 | 4096 |\n| CRM action_dim | 30 (5x6) | 6 (1x6) |\n| CGS unc_dim | 40 (30+5+5) | 8 (6+1+1) |\n| CRM params (obs_only) | 337K | 1.12M |\n\n**设计原则**: CRM 只矫正 6D pose，gripper 保持 K 样本均值（与 SmolVLA 一致）\n\n### 剩余阻塞和风险\n\n1. **Object checkpoint 下载**: 正在进行，~15GB，需等待完成后验证模型加载\n2. **CRM 需要重新训练**: OpenVLA 的 obs_dim=4096 和 action_dim=6 与 SmolVLA 不同，无法复用 SmolVLA 的 CRM checkpoint。需要：\n   - 用 OpenVLA 生成 LIBERO-Object demo 数据的 (obs_features, K_samples, expert_action) tuples\n   - 训练新的 CRM（参数量更大：1.12M vs 337K）\n3. **Inference 速度**: OpenVLA K=10 需要 10 次完整 autoregressive generation（~5s），远慢于 SmolVLA 的 shared KV cache 方案（~1s）。可能需要降低 K 或探索 KV cache 复用\n4. **modeling_prismatic.py**: Object checkpoint 需要包含自定义模型代码文件。下载完成后需确认 `modeling_prismatic.py`、`configuration_prismatic.py`、`processing_prismatic.py` 存在\n5. **Transformers 5.8.0 兼容性**: 该版本的 generate 行为与旧版不同（prefill 不触发 forward hooks）。后续如果需要更丰富的特征（multi-layer fusion），可能需要使用 `output_hidden_states=True` 配合 generate 或显式 forward pass\n\n## bjb2-40593 环境问题 (2026-05-14-15)\n\n- 无 .git repo\n- CRM cache 路径 /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache/spatial/（旧路径，非 v5）\n- Ghost PID 211962 已 kill\n- scalar seed44 OOM SIGKILL（系统 RAM，非 GPU OOM）— 已在 bjb1-32546 重试\n\n## [失败模式] submit_training_job EXIT_CODE=127 (2026-05-15)\n\ntmux 用 `sh` 而非 `bash` 执行命令，`python` 等 conda/venv 命令不在 `sh` PATH 中。修复：命令必须用 `bash -c \"source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && ...\"` 包裹。裸 `python -u ...` 有时可行（取决于服务器 PATH 配置），但不可靠。\n\n## [失败模式] EXIT_CODE=129 (SIGHUP) ≠ 真正失败 (2026-05-16)\n\n**案例**: eval-argmin-object-seed44-r2 和 crm-train-v1 都报 EXIT_CODE=129，但实验已完成并保存了完整结果。\n**根因**: tmux session 在主进程正常退出后收到 SIGHUP（终端断开或 session 被清理）。\n**规则**: EXIT_CODE=129 时不要直接判定失败。先查日志末尾确认是否已打印 \"Results saved\" / 完成信息，再检查输出文件完整性。如果都正常，标记 conclusion=success。\n\n## [失败模式] Kill 操作前必须逐参数比对 (2026-05-15)\n\n**事故**: Worker 将 norm=0.3 (norm03) 误判为 norm=0.03 (norm003) 的重复实验，kill 了有效进程。cuda:0 空闲 9 小时。\n**根因**: Worker 只看 session 名和 output_file 路径，未核对 `--max_correction_norm` 参数值。\n**规则**: kill 实验前必须 `ps aux | grep` 完整命令行，逐项比对关键参数（mode, norm, checkpoint, benchmark）。名字相似 ≠ 同一实验。\n\n## [失败模式] pooled_fisher_test.py 翻倍 bug (2026-05-16)\n\n**事故**: 脚本 KNOWN_DATA 将所有 counts ×2（假设 n_rollouts=20），输出 p=0.035（实际 p=0.110）。差点导致错误切换到 Narrative A。\n**规则**: 统计检验必须从 raw JSON 读取实际 trial counts，不能硬编码假设。任何 p<0.05 结果必须交叉验证（检查 N 是否与 registry 一致）。\n\n## [命名规范] exp_id 中 norm 写法 (2026-05-15)\n\n- Registry exp_id 不允许 `.`，norm 值用 `p` 替代小数点：norm-0p3 = 0.3, norm-0p03 = 0.03\n- 禁止缩写歧义命名（norm03 可能是 0.03 也可能是 0.3）\n- output_file 同步使用 `0p3` 格式\n\n## [部署规范] GPU 冲突防范 (2026-05-16)\n\n**事故**: bjb2-28827 cuda:2/cuda:3 上多次出现双进程共存，互相竞争 compute，效率降低 ~50%。同一 output file 被两进程写入导致数据损坏。\n**根因**: 部署命令未显式指定 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES，或未确认目标 GPU 无已有进程。\n**规则**:\n1. 所有部署命令必须显式设 `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=N`\n2. 部署前先 `nvidia-smi -i N` 确认目标 GPU 无进程\n3. 部署后 20s 内验证进程在目标 GPU 上启动\n4. 一张 GPU 只跑一个评估实验（除非 Director 明式批准共享）\n\n## [Cron 误判] nohup 实验 auto-resolve 为 failed bjb2-28827 上的 nohup 实验完成时，必须先派 analysis worker 读 JSON 确认完整性，不依赖 cron auto-resolve。\n\n## [失败模式] bjb1-18228 无法直接访问 huggingface.co (2026-05-17)\n\n**症状**:
